Business.what_it_does: Supplies enriched uranium to utilities and runs the HALEU enrichment cascade in Piketon, Ohio for the Energy Department. Exposed to the US ban on Russian enriched uranium and to advanced-reactor demand for HALEU.
Business.company_description: Centrus Energy Corp. supplies nuclear fuel components for the nuclear power industry in the United States, Japan, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Low-Enriched Uranium (LEU) and Technical Solutions. The LEU segment sells separative work units (SWU) components of LEU; natural uranium hexafluoride, uranium concentrates, and uranium conversion; and enriched uranium products to utilities that operate nuclear power plants. The Technical Solutions segment offers technical, manufacturing, engineering, and operations services to public and private sector customers. It also operates as a equipment manufacturing and engineering firm focused primarily on the energy sector. Additionally, it manufactures and ships centrifuges to Oak Ridge to support a major expansion of its uranium enrichment capacity in Ohio. The company was formerly known as USEC Inc. and changed its name to Centrus Energy Corp. in September 2014. Centrus Energy Corp. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland.

fuel_policy.item: US ban on Russian enriched uranium
fuel_policy.status: In force since Aug 11 2024 and lasts until the end of 2040. Waivers (exceptions) are only allowed until Jan 1 2028.
fuel_policy.why: Russia supplied about a fifth of the enriched uranium US reactors use. From 2028 that has to come from somewhere else.

fuel_policy.status: Centrus has waivers for all deliveries already promised to US customers in 2026 and 2027. Well over half of what it delivers through 2027 comes from Russia's Tenex.
fuel_policy.why: 2028 cuts both ways for Centrus: its cheap Russian supply ends, but demand for US-made enrichment rises.

fuel_policy.status: Since Nov 2024 Tenex needs a separate Russian export licence for each shipment to the US; extended through Dec 31 2027.
fuel_policy.why: Russia can stop shipments early at any time, which would hit Centrus before 2028.
